question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Jump the gun

options.text: To do something too soon and too quickly

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Jump the gun"** means to do something too soon and too quickly. (जल्दीबाजी करना)

 
 
• **Example:** He jumped the gun by announcing the project before it was officially approved.
 
 
 
• **"Jump the gun"** refers to acting prematurely or hastily. (जल्दबाजी में काम करना)
 
 
• **Example:** She jumped the gun and bought a new car before securing her job.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: To start all over again** (फिर से शुरुआत करना): This does not convey the meaning of "jump the gun."

 
 
• **Example:** After the failure of his first business, he decided to start all over again.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: Using a gun for sports** (खेल के लिए बंदूक का उपयोग): This is a literal interpretation and not an idiomatic meaning.
 
 
• **Example:** Using a gun for sports requires strict safety measures.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: To stop a process** (प्रक्रिया को रोकना): This is opposite in meaning to "jump the gun."
 
 
• **Example:** He decided to stop the process until he received further instructions.
